false_positive_review: The sk- pattern matched the suffix of vosk-runtime file names in two historical PM index snapshots, not API keys. Those supplemental snapshots are private-only regardless.
scan_limits: Pattern-based credential checks; large binaries classified using origin and APK ZIP contents, not an exhaustive malware/privacy proof. Internal paths/thread IDs/history remain publication-approval gated.
credentials_excluded: Private TLS keys, account tokens, global auth/chat databases, signing keys and emulator userdata are not in transfer packages.
